{{Quote|A piercing weapon of stabbing blackness, the 1,600 meter Imperial Star Destroyer is the pride of the Imperial Navy. Manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards for nearly two decades, these vessels patrol Imperial space in numbers exceeding tens of thousands|''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Handbook" />}}
The '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''', also known generally as the '''Imperial Star Destroyer''',<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> was a type of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] widely used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. There were two sub-classes of the line: the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] (also known as ''Imperator''-class), and the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars Insider 125|''Star Wars Insider'' 125]] used a fanon artwork of an ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer created by [[Ansel Hsiao]], which was labeled on his site as the ''Imperator''-class. ("Imperator" is derived from the title for the Roman Empire's head of state, which is also the origin of the French word "empereur," and by extension, the English word "[[Emperor/Legends|emperor]].")

An ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer can be made playable via the cheat "Imperial Entanglements" in the game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and the expansion ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.

{{Ship-stub}}
